mapper.select: SELECT * FROM metadata_schema WHERE id = #{id, jdbcType=OTHER}
SELECT * FROM metadata_schema WHERE data_source_id = #{dataSourceId, jdbcType=OTHER} AND name = #{name}
SELECT * FROM metadata_schema WHERE data_source_id = #{dataSourceId, jdbcType=OTHER} ORDER BY name ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO metadata_schema (id, data_source_id, name, description, created_at) VALUES (COALESCE(#{id, jdbcType=OTHER}, gen_random_uuid()), #{dataSourceId, jdbcType=OTHER}, #{name}, #{description}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP))
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM metadata_schema WHERE data_source_id = #{dataSourceId, jdbcType=OTHER}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM metadata_table WHERE id = #{id, jdbcType=OTHER}
SELECT * FROM metadata_table WHERE schema_id = #{schemaId, jdbcType=OTHER} AND name = #{name}
SELECT * FROM metadata_table WHERE schema_id = #{schemaId, jdbcType=OTHER} ORDER BY name ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO metadata_table (id, schema_id, name, description, row_count_estimate, created_at) VALUES (COALESCE(#{id, jdbcType=OTHER}, gen_random_uuid()), #{schemaId, jdbcType=OTHER}, #{name}, #{description}, #{rowCountEstimate}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP))
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM metadata_column WHERE id = #{id, jdbcType=OTHER}
SELECT * FROM metadata_column WHERE table_id = #{tableId, jdbcType=OTHER} ORDER BY name ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO metadata_column (id, table_id, name, data_type, is_nullable, is_primary_key, is_foreign_key, referenced_table, referenced_column, description, created_at) VALUES ( COALESCE(#{id, jdbcType=OTHER}, gen_random_uuid()), #{tableId, jdbcType=OTHER}, #{name}, #{dataType}, #{nullable}, #{primaryKey}, #{foreignKey}, #{referencedTable}, #{referencedColumn}, #{description}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) )
mapper.select: SELECT t.* FROM metadata_table t LEFT JOIN metadata_schema s ON t.schema_id = s.id WHERE t.name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') OR t.description ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') OR s.name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') ORDER BY t.name ASC LIMIT 50
SELECT * FROM ingestion_job WHERE id = #{id, jdbcType=OTHER}
SELECT * FROM ingestion_job WHERE data_source_id = #{dataSourceId, jdbcType=OTHER} ORDER BY started_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ingestion_job (id, data_source_id, status, started_at, ended_at, log_message) VALUES (COALESCE(#{id, jdbcType=OTHER}, gen_random_uuid()), #{dataSourceId, jdbcType=OTHER}, #{status}, #{startedAt}, #{endedAt}, #{logMessage})
mapper.select: SELECT c.referenced_table AS source_table, c.referenced_column AS source_column, t.name AS target_table, c.name AS target_column FROM metadata_column c JOIN metadata_table t ON c.table_id = t.id WHERE t.id = #{tableId, jdbcType=OTHER} AND c.is_foreign_key = true

SELECT parent_table.name AS source_table, c.referenced_column AS source_column, child_table.name AS target_table, c.name AS target_column FROM metadata_column c JOIN metadata_table child_table ON c.table_id = child_table.id JOIN metadata_table parent_table ON child_table.schema_id = parent_table.schema_id WHERE c.is_foreign_key = true AND c.referenced_table = parent_table.name AND parent_table.id = #{tableId, jdbcType=OTHER}
